mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.company_name, cl.client_name, (SELECT q.quote_status FROM quotes q WHERE q.project_id = p.project_id ORDER BY q.quote_date DESC, q.quote_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_quote_status, (SELECT q.deadline_date FROM quotes q WHERE q.project_id = p.project_id ORDER BY q.quote_date DESC, q.quote_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS deadline_date FROM projects p LEFT JOIN companies c ON p.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN clients cl ON p.client_id = cl.client_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC

SELECT p.*, cl.client_name, c.company_name FROM projects p LEFT JOIN clients cl ON p.client_id = cl.client_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON p.company_id = c.company_id WHERE p.project_id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (company_id, client_id, project_name, contract_type, order_route, status, project_remarks, project_staffname) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{clientId}, #{projectName}, #{contractType}, COALESCE(#{orderRoute}, '見積り'), #{status}, #{projectRemarks}, #{projectStaffname})
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET company_id = #{companyId}, client_id = #{clientId}, project_name = #{projectName}, contract_type = #{contractType}, status = #{status}, project_remarks = #{projectRemarks}, project_staffname = #{projectStaffname} WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
UPDATE projects SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
UPDATE projects SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE project_id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
